camel_example: aliyun eiam CreateConditionalAccessPolicy --region cn-hangzhou --Description Test_description --ConditionsConfig.Users.ExcludeOrganizationalUnits.1 ou_xxxxx --ConditionsConfig.Users.IncludeUsers.1 user_xxxx --InstanceId idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --ConditionsConfig.Users.ExcludeGroups.1 group_xxxxx --DecisionConfig.MfaAuthenticationIntervalSeconds 500 --Priority 1 --DecisionConfig.ActiveSessionReuseStatus enabled --ConditionalAccessPolicyType 'arn:alibaba:idaas:authn:access:policy:system' --ConditionsConfig.Users.ExcludeUsers.1 user_xxxx --DecisionType enforcement --ConditionsConfig.Users.IncludeGroups.1 group_xxxxx --EvaluateAt 'arn:alibaba:idaas:authn:access:rule:eval_at:after_step1' --ConditionsConfig.Applications.ExcludeApplications.1 app_xxxx --DecisionConfig.Effect allow_or_deny --ConditionsConfig.NetworkZones.IncludeNetworkZones.1 network_xxxxx --ConditionsConfig.NetworkZones.ExcludeNetworkZones.1 network_xxxxx --ConditionsConfig.Users.IncludeOrganizationalUnits.1 ou_sdfnbsxxxx --ConditionalAccessPolicyName My_conditional_access_policy --ConditionsConfig.Applications.IncludeApplications.1 app_xxxx --ClientToken 'client-token-example' --DecisionConfig.MfaAuthenticationMethods.1 ia_totp --DecisionConfig.MfaType directly_access --method POST --force
